This is a [[demographics|demography]] of the [[Population (human biology)|population]] of [[Andorra]], including [[population density]], [[Ethnic group|ethnicity]], education level, health of the populace, economic status, religious affiliations and other aspects of the population.

[[Spaniards]] form the largest [[Ethnicity|ethnic group]] in Andorra, followed by Andorrans, [[Portuguese people|Portuguese]], and [[French people|French]].<ref name=":0">{{Citation |title=Andorra |date=2025-07-23 |work=The World Factbook |url=https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/countries/andorra/#people-and-society |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250716094441/https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/countries/andorra#people-and-society |url-status=dead |archive-date=July 16, 2025 |access-date=2025-12-24 |publisher=Central Intelligence Agency |language=en}}</ref>

The national language of the country is [[Catalan language|Catalan]], a [[Romance languages|Romance language]] in the [[Western Romance]] group, spoken by over 9 million people in nearby regions of [[Spain]] and [[France]]. While Catalan is the only official language, [[Spanish language|Spanish]] is particularly widespread, and [[French language|French]] and [[Portuguese language|Portuguese]] are also commonly spoken due to [[immigration]] and geographic proximity. Most residents of Andorra are [[Multilingualism|multilingual]], typically speaking Catalan and their [[First language|native language]], as a significant portion of the population was born outside the country.<ref name=":0" />

The vast majority of the population lives in the seven urbanized [[Valley|valleys]] that form Andorra's political districts, the seven ''parròquies'' (parishes):
*[[Andorra la Vella]]
*[[Canillo]]
*[[Encamp]]
*[[Escaldes-Engordany]]
*[[La Massana]]
*[[Ordino]]
*[[Sant Julià de Lòria]]

55% of the population are of foreign nationality, with only 45% holding the Andorran nationality.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Population – Andorra in Data |url=https://andorraindata.com/andorra-in-data-2025/population/ |access-date=2026-03-15 |language=en-US}}</ref>
